title: ELIF (ELSE IF) Statement

lines.code: #ELIF (Else...If) Statement to find out the Letter Grade of a student from a score
lines.explanation: In case of more than one conditions, repeatedly increasing indentation with an 'if' statement as the 'else' block can be annoying and distracting. One solution to this is to use 'elif' statement. It is a short version of Else...IF
Assigning the integer '82' to the variable 'score'. In other words, taking in the student's score out of 100 as an input
First condition is to check if the score is above 90
If the score is above 90, the letter grade 'A' is assigned to the student
else if the score is more than or equal to 80
the letter grade 'B' is assigned to the student
else if the score is more than or equal to 70
the letter grade 'C' is assigned to the student
else if the score is more than or equal to 60
the letter grade 'D' is assigned to the student
If none of the above conditions are true then the score of the student is less than 60
If the score is less than 60, then the letter grade 'F' is assigned to the student
